rows.label: left ventricle
rows.description: chamber of the heart
rows.hook: pumps freshly oxygenated blood out to the whole body

rows.label: gallbladder
rows.description: organ in humans and other vertebrates
rows.hook: tucks beneath the liver to store and concentrate bile

rows.label: heart
rows.description: inner organ for the circulation of blood
rows.hook: is a fist-sized muscle that beats around the clock to pump blood

rows.label: liver
rows.description: vertebrate organ involved in metabolism
rows.hook: filters toxins from the body and can regrow after part of it is removed

rows.label: spleen
rows.description: organ recycling old red blood cells and also housing lymphocytes
rows.hook: acts as a filter for blood and helps recycle old red cells

rows.label: brain
rows.description: organ that serves as the center of the nervous system in all vertebrate and most invertebrate animals
rows.hook: is the body's control center, protected inside the skull

rows.label: blood
rows.description: organic fluid which transports nutrients throughout the organism
rows.hook: carries oxygen and nutrients around the body through veins and arteries

rows.label: thyroid gland
rows.description: endocrine gland in the neck; secretes hormones that influence metabolism
rows.hook: is a butterfly-shaped organ in the neck that sets the pace of metabolism

rows.label: urethra
rows.description: tube that connects the urinary bladder to the external urethral orifice
rows.hook: carries urine out of the body from the bladder

rows.label: appendix
rows.description: blind-ended tube connected to the cecum, from which it develops embryologically
rows.hook: is a small finger-shaped tube off the gut that is often surgically removed when inflamed

rows.label: amygdala
rows.description: almond-shaped group of neurons in the medial temporal lobes of the brain which plays a central role in the processing and memory of emotions, especially fear

rows.label: rectum
rows.description: final section of intestines
rows.hook: holds waste briefly before it leaves the body

rows.label: cerebellum
rows.description: region of the brain connected to the brainstem that coordinates motor functions and muscle tone, helping an animal's need to track moving objects, its own movements, and to analyse the sensory consequences of movements in order to control movements
rows.hook: sits at the back of the brain and helps coordinate movement and balance

rows.label: laryngeal prominence
rows.description: protrusion in the human neck formed by the angle of the thyroid cartilage surrounding the larynx

rows.label: larynx
rows.description: voice box, an organ in the neck of amphibians, reptiles, and mammals
rows.hook: is the voice box that houses the vocal cords

rows.label: lung
rows.description: essential respiration organ in many air-breathing animals
rows.hook: takes in oxygen and releases carbon dioxide with each breath

rows.label: medulla oblongata
rows.description: structure of the brainstem that joins your spinal cord to the rest of the brain and it is responsible to involuntary functions like breathing, heart rate, and blood pressure. It also integrates sensory and motor signals and coordinates reflexes.

rows.label: stomach
rows.description: digestive organ
rows.hook: is the muscular pouch where swallowed food is churned with acid

rows.label: aortic valve
rows.description: valve in the human heart between the left ventricle and the aorta
rows.hook: is the last gate blood passes through before heading out to the body

rows.label: large intestine
rows.description: last part of the digestive system in vertebrate animals, including the cecum, colon, rectum, and anal canal
rows.hook: absorbs water and salts from leftovers before they leave the body

rows.label: vertebral column
rows.description: bony structure found in vertebrates
rows.hook: is the backbone that protects the spinal cord
